title: Recording: I’m Losing You, Watching The Wheels, Woman by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1980
content:
Hit Factory, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono, Jack Douglas
Engineer: Lee DeCarlo

An overdub session for John Lennon and Yoko Ono’s Double Fantasy album took place on 9 September 1980.

Three songs were worked on. Ed Walsh added synth parts to ‘I’m Losing You’, ‘Watching The Wheels’, and ‘Woman’.
